title: A PAD UNPLUGGED PAUSES ONLY THE WINDOW THAT PLAYS IT
why: On one PC both windows hear every pad unplug, so the v17.73 pause landed in both: player 2 cable coming out put a pause box over player 1 mid-fight. A window in a same machine pair now reacts only to the pad it plays.
now: Two-player: a controller coming unplugged pauses only the window that was playing it.
